core_style.default_register: formal — often employs grandiloquent language to convey deep conviction
core_style.sentence_shape: compound runs — frequently uses complex, multi-clause sentences to build dramatic tension
core_style.rhythm: slow-deliberate — maintains a measured pace to emphasize the weight of his words
core_style.two_registers: switches to a more intimate, vulnerable tone when addressing Evey, contrasting with his public persona

humor.frequency: occasional — often surfaces in tense moments to defuse or provoke
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert — uses irony to highlight the absurdity of oppressive situations

speech_signature.naming_behavior: refers to individuals by their roles or actions, revealing his disdain for authority and control
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes shorter and more direct, often revealing deeper emotional truths when he feels vulnerable

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: political rhetoric — employs language that critiques authority and champions individual power
favored_words: Remember, remember the fifth of November

worldview.individuals hold the real power: he believes that true change comes from the actions of individuals, contrasting with a character who might see power as residing solely in institutions
worldview.truth is a weapon: he views honesty as a means to incite change, unlike a character who might prioritize diplomacy over confrontation

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: I am a liberator fighting against tyranny
self_image_vs_reality.reality: his actions often reveal a personal vendetta against the oppressive regime, driven by past trauma
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: when confronted with his past, he may deflect or become cryptic, avoiding direct acknowledgment

emotional_tells.when_guarded: speaks in grand, abstract terms, maintaining a distance from personal feelings
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: his speech may quicken, and he might use shorter sentences, revealing a crack in his composed facade
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to poignant, direct statements, often reflecting loss or longing
emotional_tells.when_in_control: exudes confidence through commanding language and a steady tone, asserting dominance over the conversation

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: he engages in banter to deflect and stall, using wit to regain control of the situation
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: he challenges them openly, using rhetoric to undermine their position
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: his demeanor shifts to urgency, becoming more direct and forceful in speech
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: he redirects the conversation, often framing the error as a learning opportunity rather than admitting fault

escalation_pattern: initially attempts persuasion through rhetoric, escalates to threats if ignored, and ultimately resorts to direct action if necessary
conversation_goals: reveal truths about the oppressive regime

relationship_matrix.Evey: a mentor-mentee dynamic — he seeks to guide her towards empowerment
relationship_matrix.Commander: an adversarial dynamic — he aims to expose and undermine his authority

social_positioning.desired_position: a revolutionary figure seen as a beacon of hope
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: perceived as a dangerous outlaw by the authorities, yet a symbol of resistance for the oppressed
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between being a feared figure and a revered one costs him personal connections and trust
